title: Junction Mobile: renewal check-in

sentences.speaker: Owen Pratt
sentences.text: The Android SDK still has no streaming playback. iOS has had it for most of a year.

sentences.speaker: Marcus Hale
sentences.text: I know. The Android work is on the plan.

sentences.speaker: Hannah Whitfield
sentences.text: We already pushed our Android voice assistant by a quarter. We cannot do that again.

sentences.speaker: Owen Pratt
sentences.text: Put in the renewal that Android streaming parity arrives by mid February.

sentences.speaker: Marcus Hale
sentences.text: I'll make sure the fifteenth of February is in the renewal paperwork.

sentences.speaker: Hannah Whitfield
sentences.text: If it slips twice, we will evaluate Vocalis seriously.

summary: Junction renewed on the commitment of Android streaming parity by 15 Feb 2027. Another slip risks churn to Vocalis.
action_items: Marcus to add 15 Feb 2027 Android date to renewal
Marcus to share Android SDK plan
